definitions.gloss: kid stuff; a cheap trick; something only a child would fall for
definitions.explanation: Something so simple, crude or obvious that it could only fool or satisfy a child. Used to dismiss a trick, an excuse, or a product as unworthy of an adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{子供騙|こどもだま}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That kind of cheap trick won't work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特殊効果|とくしゅこうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子供騙|こどもだま}しだ。
examples.english: The special effects in this film are kid stuff.

examples.japanese: {子供騙|こどもだま}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、かえって⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Being given an excuse a child could see through only made me angrier.

notes:
USAGE:
Always dismissive. Common as a predicate ({子供騙|こどもだま}しだ) and before a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような ({子供騙|こどもだま}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧, a trick that would only fool a child). Also written ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧だまし.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子供騙|こどもだま}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧: a cheap trick
- {子供騙|こどもだま}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: cheap tricks won't work
- {子供騙|こどもだま}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧: a flimsy toy
